question: salivary amylase helps in the digestion of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**starch**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Salivary amylase** is an enzyme found in the saliva of humans and some other animals.
 
• It begins the process of **digesting starch**, breaking it down into simpler sugars such as maltose and dextrin.
